note: overrides, the one static override Clojure has: a second REAL definition of one namespace-level name replaces the first. Measured on the corpus: 84 redefinition sites in 82 of 695 admitted files (script/m14/tmp/clj4-ontology-census.ts, instrument B). The edge is ns->name with the PRIOR declaration's line in metadata, which is the bash lane's shape (BD8b) for the same reason: both endpoints of the fact carry the same NAME, and the line is what distinguishes them. Three things must NOT produce one: a reader-conditional twin (the reader evaluates one branch and never the other), declare+defn (a forward declaration defines nothing, CLJ-D23), and defmethod (a dispatch-table insertion, not a replacement — 233 corpus sites ruled). The forbids are the half that matters: an overrides edge here would be a fabrication, so each is pinned as absent.
